title: The Call of the Wild
author: Jack London
text: Billee’s one fault was his excessive good nature, while Joe was the very opposite, sour and introspective, with a perpetual snarl and a malignant eye. Buck received them in comradely fashion, Dave ignored them, while Spitz proceeded to thrash first one and then the other.
question: How did Spitz react when the two new dogs arrived in the camp?
options: He welcomed them like good friends
He hid from them in the warm tent
He attacked both of them right away
explanation: Цитата: «Spitz proceeded to thrash first one and then the other» доказывает, что Спиц сразу напал на обоих новичков.

text:
The fridge is dark, the night is cold,
I hunt for cheese that's getting old.
My bare feet freeze upon the floor,
I drop a grape and wake the door.
Oh bitter fate, my midnight crime,
Caught snacking one more hungry time!
question: What gets the character caught in the act?
explanation: Строка «I drop a grape and wake the door» доказывает, что падение винограда выдало героя.
